build_mlp_decoder_n_tower: build an n-tower MLP decoder with configurable tower-specific hidden dims and a shared final MLP
create_get_mlp: create a static MLP Sequential module with configurable hidden dims, layer norm, dropout, and activation
run_forward_n_tower: run the n-tower decoder forward pass on paired token and dense feature tensors
review_get_decoder: review the get_decoder method that returns a list of all tower MLP modules
refactor_export_type: refactor the forward method to export embeddings from a specific tower by setting export_type
